message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a weekday (or on a weekend day that is observed on the nearest weekday) and is surrounded by at least one weekend day, giving you a stretch of three or more consecutive days off.

| Date Range (2023) | Holiday(s) | Notes |
|-------------------|------------|-------|
| **Jan 1–2** | New Year’s Day (Sunday) | New Year’s Day is on Sunday, so the weekend itself is a long weekend. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario, British Columbia, Saskatchewan) | Family Day is on Monday, creating a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Mar 18–20** | Family Day (Ontario) | Ontario’s Family Day is on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday (Friday) | Good Friday is a holiday; the following weekend gives a 3‑day break. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day (Monday) | Victoria Day is on Monday, creating a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Jul 1–2** | Canada Day (Saturday) | Canada Day falls on Saturday; the weekend itself is a long weekend. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day (Monday) | Labour Day is on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving (Monday) | Thanksgiving is on Monday, creating a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Nov 9–11** | Remembrance Day (Monday) | Remembrance Day is on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas (Monday) | Christmas is on Monday, creating a 3‑day weekend. |

### Quick Reference

- **January** – New Year’s Day (Sunday) → Jan 1–2
- **February** – Family Day (Ontario, BC, SK) → Feb 18–20
- **March** – Family Day (Ontario) → Mar 18–20
- **April** – Good Friday → Apr 7–9
- **May** – Victoria Day → May 20–22
- **July** – Canada Day (Saturday) → Jul 1–2
- **September** – Labour Day → Sep 2–4
- **October** – Thanksgiving → Oct 7–9
- **November** – Remembrance Day → Nov 9–11
- **December** – Christmas → Dec 23–25

> **Tip for App Integration**  
> If you need to support provincial variations (e.g., Family Day in Ontario vs. British Columbia), you can store each holiday with its applicable provinces and then filter by the user’s location. The table above covers the nationwide long weekends that apply to all Canadians.
